pages.text: Spotted a Swamp Hag. Around 2.5 blocks tall, all bone and twisted, overgrown limbs. Glowing yellow eyes. It staggered as it moved — eerie, like it shouldn’t be walking at all.$(br2)Fights like a typical hostile mob, hits with average strength. Odd thing is, sometimes it doesn’t flinch when struck — seems to resist knockback now and then.
